entries.notes: Baseline for Navigator 2.0 filtering and Navigator 10 register map.
Prepared API release with optional local web supplement and default-safe Navigator 10 firmware register polling.
Beta integration line consumes the optional web supplement, faster model detection and reduced Navigator 10 web delay.
Adds stable web supplement metadata/helpers, optional firmware probing and Navigator 10 WebSocket reconnect hardening for the next integration pin.
Fixes Navigator 2.0 model detection: address 1072 is no longer treated as a Navigator 10 indicator, preventing Illegal Data Address errors during first setup.
Resolves heating-circuit address overlaps, hardens web-clients against session leaks and race conditions, disables double retry, adds quiet_pymodbus_logging() helper.
Adds post-batch validation for corrupt enum values and supports 8-room zone modules.
Release vehicle for zone-room count fixes and room-mode batch read recovery reported in HASS issues #68 and #69.
Stability and performance patch: TimeoutError retry handling, skip permanently failed registers in read_register(), optimized read_batch() grouping, and defensive Navigator 10 websocket close.

Optional web client optimization and hardening: Nav10 request error tuples built once at import, single auth-frame parse, Nav2 close() no longer leaks session state on failure, plus expanded web client test coverage.
Maintenance release with refreshed release metadata after 0.6.4.
Adds a stable query for registers rejected with Modbus Illegal Data Address, enabling consumers to maintain their own polling skip-list.
Security and reliability patch for web host validation, safe Modbus writes, authentication handling, transient failure recovery, LF normalization, and reduced Navigator 2.0 startup traffic.

Hardens Navigator 10/2.0/Pro batch reads: never spans unrequested address gaps, validates recovery reads, quarantines suspect registers, preserves documented sentinel values, and bounds humidity to 0-100%.
Ignores documented -1.0 flow-temperature sentinels for unconfigured Navigator heating-circuit slots during model detection.
Restores the documented Navigator register map and humidity float decoding, and reconnects after pymodbus no-response errors.
Declares unavailable sentinels verified on Navigator 10 hardware so normal optional-register values do not trigger corrupt-batch recovery and repeated warnings.
Hardens transport failure propagation, recognizes the verified cascade-unavailable sentinel, supports consumer-driven batch quarantine, and adds explicitly acknowledged custom-register writes.
Stabilizes Navigator 2.0 local web login for direct IPv4/IPv6 hosts by allowing IP-literal cookies on API-owned aiohttp sessions.

Detects non-contiguous heating circuits (e.g. A+D) via active-mode cross-check and exposes heating circuits B-G in the Navigator 10 web client. Source: two-device Navigator 10 ALM capture (2026-07-16).

Marks zone-module room relay registers (zm{z}_room{r}_relay) as binary status bits so the Home Assistant integration can expose them as binary_sensor entities with on/off instead of numeric 0/1 sensors. Closes Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass#128.

Adds neutral binary register semantics metadata. The Home Assistant integration validates this API through its api-main CI path, while its released manifest pin and integration version remain unchanged until a separate tested addon release.

Fixes Navigator 2.0 model detection: register power_limit_hp (4108) returning a sentinel value (e.g. -1.0 / 0.0) on IDM Terra SWM controllers is no longer misclassified as Navigator 10. See Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass#44.
Fixes Navigator 10 model detection when power_limit_hp (4108) is set to sentinel/default -1.0 by probing address 4001 (booster_fault), and adds set_model_info() helper.

Fixes Navigator 2.0 model detection: a booster_fault (4001) response of the declared 'not configured' sentinel (255 / 0xFFFF) is no longer misclassified as Navigator 10; only a non-sentinel 4001 value proves the Navigator 10 booster block, consistent with the 4108 plausibility check. See Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass#170.

Adds a strict tertiary Navigator 10 indicator: the Navigator-10-only registers power_consumption_hp (4122) and thermal_power_flow_sensor (4126) must BOTH respond. Closes the gap from 0.8.5 where a real Navigator 10 in standby without a configured booster (4108 unplausible, 4001 sentinel) was misdetected as Navigator 2.0. Verified live on a Navigator 10 controller (firmware NAV10_20.24-880-g265e09c4a). Navigator 2.0 / IDM Terra SWM stay Navigator 2.0 because they reject 4122/4126 with Modbus Exception 2. See Xerolux/idm-heatpump-hass#170.

Sentinel authority: adds RegisterDef.effective_sentinel_values and datatype-based default sentinels (FLOAT -1.0, UCHAR 255, UINT16 65535, INT16 -1/-32768), plus explicit pump-status opt-outs. Makes the integration's former numeric heuristic data-driven and device-specific (SENT-01). No address/type/write-path changes.

First 0.9.x stable. Bundles 0.8.6 (Navigator 10 standby detection via 4122/4126) and 0.8.7 (sentinel authority). Additive and backward-compatible only. Verified live on Navigator 10 (firmware NAV10_20.24-880-g265e09c4a); Navigator 2.0 / Terra SWM covered by the unit-test matrix.
